tasks.subject: Research the WoW Forever HUD cooldown/GCD/secret API contract
tasks.description: Read and execute bench/briefs/brief_forever_hud_api_2026-11-08.md. WoW Forever only (Camelot 1.60.1, origin/forever); read-only lane, no product edits. Deliverable: bench/forever_hud_api_2026-11-08.md + desks/forever-hud-api/journal.md + done signal. Answer with exact origin/forever:<path>:<line> citations: when cooldown data is secret (C_Secrets predicates + SecretWhenCooldownsRestricted), the sanctioned duration-object pass-through path for swipe/text/GCD, allowed vs forbidden LuaDurationObject methods when HasSecretValues() is true, countdown text/binding sinks, trinket item cooldown face, and the secret-value cache matrix for HUD/LibGlobalCooldown. Use only /home/sam/wow-ui-source (read-only git), /home/sam/SwedgeTimer, /home/sam/SuperSwingTimer-WoW. No web search. Mark runtime-only facts UNCONFIRMED. Enterprise grade: no guessing, no remembered facts.
tasks.output:
Delivered the Forever-only (origin/forever eac30af59, 1.60.1 (70790)) cooldown/GCD/secret API contract: bench/forever_hud_api_2026-11-08.md (760 lines, 12 sections) + desks/forever-hud-api/journal.md + done signal. Every client claim is cited origin/forever:<path>:<line>; runtime-only facts are UNCONFIRMED with exact /run probes (P1-P11 / U1-U12).

Core verdicts:
1) Restricted swipe IS achievable. C_Spell.GetSpellCooldownDuration (SpellDocumentation.lua:326-343) has NO SecretWhenCooldownsRestricted (contrast GetSpellCooldown :312), so its LuaDurationObject is a non-secret handle whose values may be secret (HasSecretValues, LuaDurationObjectAPIDocumentation.lua:350-364). CooldownFrame:SetCooldownFromDurationObject (FrameAPICooldownDocumentation.lua:307-318) is the only cooldown setter WITHOUT SecretArgumentsAddAspect. SecretArguments=AllowedWhenUntainted constrains secret ARGUMENTS only, stated in Blizzard's own prose at Blizzard_UnitFrame/Shared/UnitFrameUtil.lua:487. This supersedes bench/secret_api_matrix_2026-11-06.md:156 and bench/secret_hud_fix_2026-11-06.md:17 ("swipe cannot be driven from a restricted read") with evidence.
2) Countdown text: C_DurationUtil.CreateDurationTextBinding + SetFontString/SetDuration/SetFormatter(C_StringUtil.CreateSecondsFormatter) + SetTextColorCurve(C_CurveUtil.CreateColorCurve, Enum.DurationTextBindingProperty.RemainingDuration) renders text and warn colour natively; the addon must never format (SecondsFormatter:Format is AllowedWhenUntainted) or read the text back (GetText = SecretReturnsForAspect Text).
3) GCD: detection without numbers via SpellCooldownInfo.isOnGCD/isActive (NeverSecret, SpellSharedDocumentation.lua:26,30); swipe from GetSpellCooldownDuration(probe,false). Root cause of today's dark GCD: LibGlobalCooldown.poll_gcd:152-171 reads api.GetSpellCooldown, which compat answers 0,0,0,0,true under restriction (compat.lua:471-473), so gcd_duration never arms.
4) Trinkets: NO duration-object API for item cooldowns exists in the whole branch, and no item secrecy predicate. Contract bug: the 4th return of GetInventoryItemCooldown is isOnGCD (Blizzard CooldownViewer.lua:1017,1021), but compat.lua:1565-1584 + hud.lua:341-350,418-431 read it as restricted -> grey unknown face + no swipe for the whole GCD window.
5) Cache rules: a secret table key poisons every access and hard-errors (Blizzard_AuraContainerGroups.lua:12-25); the secure secretunwrap+settablesecurity pattern is unavailable to addons because secretunwrap=nil in Blizzard_EnvironmentCleanup/Mainline/EnvironmentCleanup.lua:280; scrubsecretvalues/issecretvalue remain. All six addon cache groups mapped with minimal fixes (hud known_names/known_cache/layout_cache/icons/trinkets/TRINKET_STATE/PREVIEW_STATE; LibGlobalCooldown gcd_*/current_spell_*; compat wrappers), including replacing icons[i].cd_start/cd_duration with the object handle + a plain token.

Read-only: no product file, test, TOC, doc or git state touched; no web search; only the 3 deliverables written.

tasks.output:
Delivered bench/aura_row_reference_2026-11-08.md (869 lines) + desks/aura-row-reference/journal.md + done signal; read-only, no product edits.

CONTENTS: reference code map with file:line for every mechanic the brief listed (support/secrecy gates 36-133, per-class lists 326-660 + AppendUnique merge 591-615, CreateAuraContainerFrame 922-933, CreateAuraGroupContainer 942-1008, StyleAuraButton 807-916, BuildAuraSpellIDMap 652-660, GetAnchorBar/ComputeIconYOffset/ApplyContainerAnchors 1038-1452, IsForeverDebuffRowPopulated 1380-1409, 0.15 s UpdateForeverAuraIcons 1642-1732, PLAYER_LOGIN/PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD init retry 1757-1784, hand-over wrap 1458-1485); full six-class id tables with provenance markers (post-merge: buffs 26/17/9/12/22/11 = 97; debuffs 29/19/19/30/19/44 = 160 after excluding 27019; shared 5; racial 10 keys); API confirmation table against origin/forever tip eac30af5 (templates + allowUntaintedCreation, AuraContainerSortMethod/Direction, C_AuraContainerUtil, C_Secrets + Enum.SecrecyLevel, C_UnitAuras annotations, includeSpellIDs privilege gating, maxDuration, AddAuraGroup vs AddAuraSlot, secretwrap container sizing); port plan for a new Forever-only aura_icons.lua (exact gate, main.lua post_init seam, container config, fixed-band anchoring over ST:iter_hands/get_bar_frame, options/defaults keys with orders, TOC/toc_check/run.sh edits, 18 test cases + 8 mutation proofs, risks + do-not-copy list); 13-row UNCONFIRMED in-client checklist with exact /run probes.

KEY FINDINGS FOR DOWNSTREAM: (1) the client sizes aura containers through secretwrap (Blizzard_CustomAuraContainer.lua:796-801) so container height/top can be secret — never measure an aura container; the port reserves a fixed band instead of anchoring the buff row to the measured debuff row (this invalidates the naive reading of the reference's own between-rows anchor). (2) Own-caster debuffs need no CLEU: "HARMFUL|PLAYER" is the client filter (AuraUtil.lua:274), and includeSpellIDs identity matching is privilege-gated, so the debuff row is empty on friendly targets by design. (3) UnitAura does not exist on Forever (classic-only deprecated shims) -> no classic fallback needed. (4) 27019 is reference-marked TBC-only -> excluded; stance ids (Aspects/Seals/Stances/Shields/Forms/Stealth) are a separate left-slot feature, not ported, and must not leak into the buff row.
